params.body:
After #47 the home hero was a fixed 610px on desktop. On a 1920x1080 screen that left the header, hero and category bar well short of the bottom, with the next section showing as a strip below.

From `lg` on the hero now takes the height that is left of the first screen: `min-h-[calc(100svh-281px)]`, where 281px is the header (176px) plus the category bar (105px). The text is centred vertically in it. The content height stays the minimum, so a short screen (1366x768) keeps its buttons in view instead of squeezing the text.

Measured locally:

| Screen | Hero height |
|---|---|
| 1366x768 | 610px (content minimum) |
| 1440x900 | 619px |
| 1920x1080 | 799px |
| 2560x1440 | 1159px |

From 1440px wide, header, hero and category bar end at the bottom of the screen. Phones and tablets are unchanged.

If the category bar ever wraps to two lines, it ends a little below the fold.

All hero text still reaches AAA at 390, 768, 1024, 1440 and 1920px. Full suite: 85 tests green.
params.title: Home hero: fill the first screen on desktop
